attchmntText: C.E. Info Systems Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 17, 2026, titled "C.E. Info Systems Limited announcing integration of MapmyIndia Mappls with Arattai to enable its users to seamlessly navigate to chat-shared locations".
voiceSummary: C.E. Info Systems Limited submitted a press release to BSE and NSE regarding the integration of MapmyIndia Mappls with Arattai. The announcement states that Arattai users can now open locations shared in chats and groups directly in the Mappls App to get turn-by-turn directions. This integration connects MapmyIndia’s navigation app with Zoho’s messaging app. The feature is available on Android and iOS devices. Users can view route details, travel time, and trip costs before starting navigation. The press release highlights benefits such as door-level guidance, 3D junction views, and real-time safety alerts. It mentions that Mappls App has over 45 million users in India. The company emphasizes data privacy and technological sovereignty in this partnership.

attchmntText: Press Release - "Embassy Developments Unveils Embassy ONE Residences - an Exclusive Collection of 59 Ultra-Luxury Managed Residences".
voiceSummary: Embassy Developments Limited announced the launch of Embassy ONE Residences, a collection of 59 ultra-luxury managed residences in Bengaluru. The project has a Gross Development Value of approximately 1,400 crore rupees. This launch brings the company's cumulative Gross Development Value launched in fiscal year 2027 to around 9,000 crore rupees. The development is located at Mekhri Circle and features residences ranging from 4,500 to 15,000 square feet. The project has received an Occupancy Certificate and all requisite approvals. The launch introduces Fifth Key, a luxury hospitality brand for select residences. The announcement was filed on November 17, 2026.

attchmntText: Indo Farm Equipment Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Indo Farm Equipment Limited filed an investor presentation with BSE and NSE on November 17, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue from operations of Rs. 11,459.46 lakhs for Q2FY27, up 10.30% year-on-year. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 539.99 lakhs, an 8.33% increase. H1FY27 revenue reached Rs. 22,483.76 lakhs, with PAT at Rs. 1,105.73 lakhs. EBITDA margin declined to 12.63% from 14.08% in Q2FY26 due to higher input prices. The company is entering the tower crane market with production ready in the current financial year. A new pick and carry crane project at Bhud Site, Baddi, is under construction, with commercial production expected in the current FY. Barota Finance Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary, manages an asset under management of over Rs. 135 crores with 5,000 active customers.

attchmntText: CL Educate Limited has informed the Exchange about Credit Rating- New
voiceSummary: CL Educate Limited has informed the stock exchanges that ICRA Limited assigned a credit rating of ICRA BBB with a stable outlook to its proposed Non-Convertible Debentures of Rs. 100 crore. attchmntText: Almondz Global Securities Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Almondz Global Securities Limited submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 11, 2026. Consolidated revenue grew 17.9% year-on-year to INR40.09 crores, with profit rising 2.4 times to INR9.13 crores. Infrastructure consultancy revenue increased 21.1% to INR31.35 crores, supported by an order book exceeding INR400 crores. The green energy business reported revenue of INR202.24 crores and profit of INR12.59 crores, with the Odisha plant now operational. Financial services revenue rose 2.7% to INR8.05 crores. The company is pursuing a scheme of arrangement to demerger its infrastructure consultancy into a separate listed entity, with NSE approval pending. The proposed share exchange ratio is 666 shares of Almondz Global Infra Consultant Limited for every 10,000 shares of Almondz Global Securities.

attchmntText: In accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, read with the applicable SEBI circulars, we wish to inform you that Aether Industries Limited has today entered into a Facility Development and Supply Agreement with Baker Petrolite LLC, a Baker Hughes Company, as attached.
voiceSummary: Aether Industries Limited entered into a Facility Development and Supply Agreement with Baker Petrolite LLC on November 17, 2026. The agreement establishes India’s first dedicated manufacturing facility for Drag Reducing Agents at Site Magnum in Panoli, Gujarat. Aether will serve as the exclusive manufacturing supplier for this program. The facility is located at Aether’s existing Site 5. The counterparty is incorporated in the United States of America. The transaction is not a related party transaction. It was entered into on an arm’s length basis. Baker Petrolite is an existing customer of Aether. The agreement is a long-term supply arrangement. There is no change in shareholding or management control. The press release highlights the strategic importance of this collaboration for energy infrastructure markets.
